name: Horseshoe Hill Orchard
description: In US 151, WI, Horseshoe Hill Orchard raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
